attchmntText: MRF Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 10, 2026, titled "Press Release ".
voiceSummary: MRF Limited held a Board Meeting on 10th November, 2026, to consider Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Consolidated total income was Rs 8791.58 Crores, compared to Rs 7489.00 Crores in the corresponding quarter of 2025. Consolidated profit before tax stood at Rs 521.81 Crores, down from Rs 700.45 Crores. After a tax provision of Rs 134.82 Crores, consolidated net profit was Rs 386.99 Crores, compared to Rs 527.43 Crores previously. The Board declared an interim dividend of Rs 3 per share for the financial year ending 31st March, 2027. The company noted strong sales growth but highlighted adverse impacts from rising raw material prices.

attchmntText: MRF Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Interim Dividend  is 17-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: MRF Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board on 10th November 2026. The company declared an interim dividend of Rs.3 per equity share, with a record date of 17th November 2026 and payment on or after 1st December 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was Rs.8,523.96 Crores for the quarter and Rs.16,815.52 Crores for the half year. Standalone profit for the period from continuing operations stood at Rs.369.15 Crores for the quarter and Rs.843.52 Crores for the half year. Earnings per share were Rs.870.40 for the quarter and Rs.1,988.90 for the half year. The Board also submitted the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow Statement. Independent auditors issued a limited review report confirming compliance with applicable standards.
